verdict.rationale: BILL documents a REST v3 API, but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the standard spec locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on every path. The llms.txt file and the docs MCP server are documentation aids, not an API spec, so they do not count here.
